thread:
alex: Quick check — onboarding kepler-7b for the catalog. I pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/kepler-7b/v1/weights.tar.gz and a tokenizer bundle to s3://redwood-models/kepler-7b/v1/tokenizer.zip. Need confirmation on: weights path correctness, tokenizer quirk (saw +1 token on some prompts), config validation, and someone to run a couple perf sweeps (latency and batch sizing).

maya: I can grab the tokenizer and repro the +1. Do you have a failing example? :eyes:

alex: simple repro: input "Summarize: The quick brown fox" -> expected tokens 12, got 13 in our tokenize_and_count test. Happens with trailing colon sometimes. Paste of failing snippet below.

alex: ```
# failing unit
tokens = tok.encode("Summarize: The quick brown fox")
print(len(tokens))  # 13 but baseline expects 12
# tokenizer version: spm v0.9, vocab 50256
```

owen: hmm likely SentencePiece vs legacy BP encoding mismatch. Did you import the tokenizer with add_prefix_space=False vs True? That often shifts counts on punctuation.

viv: also check special tokens mapping — if colon is mapped to two subtokens on this model's vocab it can add +1. I can dump tokenize details.

maya: pulling tokenizer now.

jen: for config validation, FYI the candidate serving config is under infra/catalog/kepler-7b/serve.yaml. Quick glance: batch_size=8, max_seq=1024, kv_cache=true, quantize=fp16. Might need lower default batch for our tiny hosts.

alex: thx. here's the config snippet I used locally:

alex: ```yaml
model_path: s3://redwood-models/kepler-7b/v1/weights.tar.gz
tokenizer_path: s3://redwood-models/kepler-7b/v1/tokenizer.zip
batch_size: 8
max_seq_length: 1024
kv_cache: true
quantization: fp16
compile_flags:
  - optimize_attention
```

owen: config looks OK but change default batch_size to 4 for the catalog entry to be conservative. Also add an explicit tokenizer param:

owen: ```yaml
tokenizer:
  type: sentencepiece
  add_prefix_space: true
  trim_offsets: true
```

maya: confirmed the +1 — tokenizer bundle had add_prefix_space=False. Re-encoded with add_prefix_space=True and counts match baseline. I'll repackage and push to same s3 path with a new checksum. :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: perf job queued: /artifacts/perf/kepler-7b/172903/ (runs for batch sizes [1,2,4,8], seq lengths [128,512,1024]).

alex: great. Can someone run a quick smoke on the serving runtime (single GPU) for latency tail P95 and throughput for batch 1/4? No need for long sweeps, just smoke runs.

jen: I can run smoke tonight. Will post results here and attach logs. ETA ~5h.

owen: pinging @jen for a PR review when you update serve.yaml — small change on default batch_size + tokenizer block.

jen: noted, will open PR and assign @owen. Also will include perf logs link in the PR body.

viv: small gotcha: if kv_cache=true and batch_size>1 we need to ensure KV sharing is disabled for seq streaming mode, else memory spikes. Add a comment in serve.yaml: "kv_cache recommended for single-request low-latency paths; disable for streaming multi-batch".

alex: good call. I'll update the onboarding checklist to mention that.

perf-bot: smoke results uploaded: /artifacts/perf/kepler-7b/172903/smoke-summary.txt

jen: smoke summary: batch=1 P50=42ms P95=88ms, batch=4 throughput=18 rps sustained, mem peak ~11.2GB. No OOMs. Logs: /artifacts/perf/kepler-7b/172903/logs.tar.gz

alex: solid. Can we try batch=2 quick to see linearity? If throughput scales ~x2 from batch1 to batch2 that's a good sign.

jen: running batch=2 quick now, will post.

~10m later

jen: batch=2 quick: P50=48ms P95=102ms, throughput=9.5 rps. Not perfect linear but acceptable given kv overhead. Uploaded new trace: /artifacts/perf/kepler-7b/172903/batch2-trace.json

owen: thanks. Action items:
- maya: push tokenizer bundle with add_prefix_space=true (done?)
- jen: open PR with serve.yaml edits (default batch_size->4, tokenizer block, kv_cache note) + attach perf logs
- owen: review PR
- alex: update onboarding checklist and catalog entry to include tokenizer checksum and perf summary link

maya: pushed new tokenizer with sha256: abc123... to same s3 path and added manifest file.

jen: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/infra/+/12345 — assigned to @owen. Contains perf logs and serve.yaml change.

owen: reviewing now. quick comment: change quantization -> auto (so catalog picker can override). Will request that in review.

alex: thanks all. If no blockers after review we'll mark kepler-7b as "catalog-ready (smoke)" and schedule full perf sweeps during next perf sprint.

viv: :thumbsup:

alex: closing thread once PR merged. :sparkles:
